SELECT cr.checkin_id AS checkinId, cr.checkin_no AS checkinNo, cr.reservation_id AS reservationId, r.reservation_no AS reservationNo, cr.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.schedule_no AS scheduleNo, s.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, s.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, c.course_type AS courseType, s.coach_id AS coachId, coach.coach_name AS coachName, cr.member_id AS memberId, m.member_no AS memberNo, COALESCE(m.real_name, m.nickname) AS memberName, m.mobile AS memberMobile, cr.card_id AS cardId, r.reservation_type AS reservationType, mc.card_name AS cardName, mc.plan_type AS planType, mc.card_status AS cardStatus,
mc.remain_times AS remainTimes, mc.balance_amount AS balanceAmount, s.schedule_date AS scheduleDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, cr.checkin_type AS checkinType, cr.checkin_time AS checkinTime, cr.consume_times AS consumeTimes, cr.consume_amount AS consumeAmount, cr.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, su.nick_name AS operatorUserName, cr.checkin_status AS checkinStatus, cr.remark AS remark, cr.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: ORDER BY cr.checkin_time DESC, cr.checkin_id DESC
ORDER BY cr.checkin_time DESC, cr.checkin_id DESC

FROM fit_checkin_record cr INNER JOIN fit_course_schedule s ON s.schedule_id = cr.schedule_id AND s.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course_reservation r ON r.reservation_id = cr.reservation_id AND r.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = cr.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_course c ON c.course_id = s.course_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = s.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_coach coach ON coach.coach_id = s.coach_id AND coach.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member_card mc ON mc.card_id = cr.card_id AND mc.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = cr.operator_user_id AND su.del_flag = '0' WHERE cr.del_flag = '0' AND cr.checkin_id = #{checkinId} LIMIT 1
